prompt:
BASE DRAWING
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: loose hand-drawn note for the Byggkollektivet homepage, intended to be isolated later
Primary request: one quick, casual drawing of a simple wooden window made by a competent builder who is only reasonably good at drawing
Subject: a slightly crooked rectangle for the window frame, one uneven vertical divider, a doubled sill line, one opening arrow, and one tiny abandoned corner-detail scribble off to the side
Style/medium: fast black ballpoint pen and soft graphite; sparse, scratchy, wobbly, hesitant marks; overshot corners, a corrected line, uneven pressure, incomplete edges; charming working-note quality
Composition/framing: portrait canvas, the main window occupies only the central forty percent, with large empty space around it; no wall, no room, no plants, no shadows, no rendering, no crosshatched surfaces
Background: perfectly flat pure white only, with no paper grain, no cream tint, no checkerboard, no shadows
Text: no readable words; one or two tiny illegible handwritten squiggles are allowed
Constraints: radically simple and low-detail, recognizable but clearly not professional illustration, less than thirty principal strokes, no fill areas, isolated dark marks on pure white
Avoid: precise geometry, symmetry, CAD drafting, architectural presentation drawing, perspective scene, realistic materials, polished line art, vector cleanliness, detailed joinery, decorative composition, calligraphy, color, border, tape, watermark

ANNOTATION OVERLAY
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: handwritten annotation overlay for a transparent architectural sketch on the Byggkollektivet homepage
Primary request: create only three small groups of loose handwritten working notes and pencil scribbles, as if a Swedish carpenter quickly annotated a window sketch
Subject: three short, mostly illegible handwritten note fragments; two crooked arrows; one roughly circled correction; one crossed-out mark
Style/medium: hurried soft graphite and black ballpoint pen, uneven baseline, inconsistent letter size, hesitant pressure, messy but thoughtful; written by a competent builder, not a calligrapher or illustrator
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3 canvas; keep the center mostly empty for an existing window drawing; place one note near the upper right, one near the lower left, and a tiny correction near the middle right; abundant empty space
Text: handwriting should suggest casual Swedish notes but remain mostly illegible; no polished or typeset words
Background: perfectly flat pure white only, no texture, no cream tint, no checkerboard, no shadows
Constraints: annotations only, no window, no building, no objects, no decorative flourishes; sparse marks, small scale, natural mistakes
Avoid: handwriting font, calligraphy, clean lettering, typography, perfect arrows, diagram styling, professional architectural annotation, paper texture, border, tape, watermark

Post-processing: both flat generated backgrounds were converted to real alpha transparency and the handwritten annotation layer was composited over the approved window drawing. The generated marks and their composition were otherwise preserved.
